title: Token & Risk Disclosure
subtitle: PNL is designed for participation and coordination within PonyLife. Participation involves uncertainty and risk.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose of PNL
paragraphs: PNL is a participation and coordination token used inside the PonyLife ecosystem to support internal accounting, alignment, and coordination mechanisms.
PNL is not equity, not ownership in PonyLife, and not a guarantee of outcomes.

sections.heading: 2. What PNL Is Not
bullets: Not a yield or interest-bearing instrument
Not a promise of price appreciation or guaranteed liquidity

sections.heading: 3. Allocation and Internal Assessment
paragraphs: PonyLife may perform internal, non-binding assessments of submitted Works for coordination purposes.
Based on internal assessment, participation units (PNL) may be reserved or allocated to reflect conditional involvement in the ecosystem.
Internal assessments are experimental and do not constitute market valuation.

sections.heading: 4. Outcomes Are Uncertain
paragraphs: Visibility, commercialization, and other outcomes depend on market conditions and coordination effectiveness.
PonyLife does not guarantee outcomes and does not provide financial advice.

sections.heading: 5. Market Risk (If External Markets Exist)
paragraphs: If PNL is traded externally, market prices may be volatile and may not reflect platform activity.
External market activity occurs independently and is not presented by PonyLife as an investment opportunity.

sections.heading: 6. Technology and Security Risks
bullets: Smart contract vulnerabilities or unexpected behavior
Network congestion, outages, or protocol changes
Wallet security risks (loss of keys, phishing, malware)

sections.heading: 7. Regulatory and Legal Risks
paragraphs: Rules for digital assets may vary by jurisdiction and may change over time.
You are responsible for understanding applicable laws, regulations, and tax obligations in your jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 8. No Guarantees
paragraphs: PNL participation does not guarantee financial returns, outcomes, or liquidity.
Any use of the platform is at your own risk.
